name: CAD Coin
oneLiner: CADC is Loon's centralized Canadian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against CAD held in trust at a FINTRAC-regulated Canadian institution.
collateral: Canadian dollars and cash equivalents (liquid securities with original maturity ≤ 90 days) held 1:1 in a segregated account at a Canadian financial institution, in trust for CADC holders
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for CAD through Loon (FINTRAC-registered MSB, formerly issued by PayTrie); CADC is burned on redemption and minted on deposit

mintAuthority.summary: CADC is issued by Loon (FINTRAC-registered MSB); on-chain owner/masterMinter across the EVM deployments is a set of Gnosis Safe multisigs with identical 3 signers (2/3 threshold) operated by the issuer.

controls.label: Loon CADC issuance backend
controls.evidence: Loon controls 1:1 mint on CAD deposit and burn on redemption against segregated trust reserves; minting is issuer-operated with no permissionless route. The issuer-controlled masterMinter Safes can authorize minters and change mint allowances, so this issuer failure domain can raise the effective mint cap.
